data.name: Raimei Gen
data.description: A lightning-infused genjutsu that damages the target while enhancing the user’s genjutsu output.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a genjutsu that strikes %target’s mind like a bolt of thunder. A flash of light, a roar of psychic lightning—and the illusion crashes down with jarring force. Neural signals distort, and the target reels from imagined pain while %user’s own genjutsu becomes supercharged, amplified by the illusion’s residual current. The echo of thunder leaves a lingering charge in the user’s aura, intensifying their next illusions.

data.name: Razor Water Whip
data.description: A slicing stream of chakra-forged water that lashes the enemy and heightens the user’s offensive potential.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes out with a swift, bladed whip of condensed water chakra that carves into %target with razor precision. As the whip extends and recoils, it channels violent chakra flow through %user’s system, boosting their ninjutsu potency for subsequent strikes.

data.name: Rengoku Rō
data.description: A devastating genjutsu attack that overwhelms the opponent’s mind with intense illusionary torment.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and channels overwhelming genjutsu energy, summoning a fiery illusion that consumes reality around the victim. Walls of flame twist into phantasmal figures, dragging %target into an endless mental prison of agony and despair. Every sensory input is distorted, disorienting the enemy and leaving their will fractured under the crushing weight of illusionary suffering.

data.name: Resounding Crescendo
data.description: A rhythmic taijutsu strike that deals heavy damage and hardens the user’s defense.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes with precise rhythm—each movement building in intensity until the final blow crashes into %target like a drumbeat shaking the air. The force of the hit reverberates through the user’s body, channeling momentum inward. As the impact fades, hardened chakra settles over %user’s frame, reducing damage taken from future blows.

data.name: Rib Breaker
data.description: A brutal taijutsu strike that damages the enemy and makes their jutsu cost more chakra and stamina to perform
data.battleDescription: %user drives forward with a tightly coiled strike, targeting the ribs with pinpoint precision. The moment their fist crashes into %target’s side, chakra surges through the blow—fracturing internal flow and rupturing control points. The hit leaves more than bruises—it disrupts how %target channels energy. From that moment on, their chakra and stamina slip through the cracks, making every technique cost more to maintain.

data.name: Ryūsa Kōka
data.description: An earth-style reinforcement that boosts offensive power and hardens the user’s body against incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user envelops their body in a dense, moving layer of fortified earth chakra. The hardened flow surges with pressure, sharpening attacks and absorbing impact, allowing the user to strike harder while enduring more punishment.

data.name: Seimyaku
data.description: A subtle pulse of chakra that suppresses enemy recovery while shielding the user from harm
data.battleDescription: %user emits a deep, controlled pulse of refined chakra that interferes with %target’s ability to recover while reinforcing their own defenses. The technique dampens restorative energies around the enemy and surrounds the user in a chakra field that cushions incoming attacks.

data.name: Severed Pulse
data.description: A chakra-disrupting technique that weakens healing effects and leaves the enemy more vulnerable to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a cutting wave of chakra that severs the natural flow of recovery within %target. The disruption corrodes regenerative functions and breaks down their guard, amplifying the effect of all incoming attacks.

data.name: Shōen Gen'ei
data.description: A blazing genjutsu assault that scorches the battlefield and boosts the user's offensive momentum.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes into a mirage of heat and haze, reappearing in flickering bursts as spectral flames race across the battlefield. The illusion strikes %target with scorching clarity, searing the mind as much as the body. Each movement sharpens the user's own aggression, amplifying the potency of their next attacks.

data.name: Spectral Chain
data.description: A spectral genjutsu that deals damage and prevents the user from being stunned.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a swift, entrancing sequence of hand seals. Spectral chains erupt from the void around %target, latching onto their mind and spirit. The illusion tightens with each pulse, sending jolts of phantom pain and confusion through their senses. As the chains bind %target in this nightmarish loop, the user is enveloped in a stabilizing aura, making them immune to stunning interruptions while the illusion holds.

data.name: Stone Breaker
data.description: A crushing blow that deals damage and lowers the enemy’s overall damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user twists mid-air and drives a stone-weighted weapon into %target’s torso with brutal force. The sudden blow reverberates through their body, disrupting their chakra flow and reducing the power behind their next attacks.

data.name: Stone Dance Slash
data.description: A fierce earth-based slash that delivers crushing damage with precision and force.
data.battleDescription: %user channels seismic chakra into their weapon and dashes toward %target, unleashing a spiraling slash infused with the force of crumbling mountains. A vortex of rotating stones surrounds the user, creating a shifting defense and amplifying the power of the strike. The impact sends jagged rock fragments flying, shaking the ground beneath and leaving a cracked, ruptured battlefield in its wake.

data.name: Stone Hammer Kick
data.description: A crushing earth-infused kick that deals heavy damage and fortifies the user’s defense.
data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their leg with dense earth chakra, then launches into a spinning downward kick that slams into %target like a falling slab of stone. Upon impact, shockwaves ripple through the ground, and fragments of hardened chakra recoil around %user’s body. These chakra shards linger like a shell, absorbing impact and dulling incoming attacks.

data.name: Stone Pillar Strike
data.description: A crushing blow of solid earth that shields the user from incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their chakra into the ground, summoning a jagged pillar of stone that erupts beneath %target. As the impact lands, fragments of chakra-reinforced rock encase the user, forming a hardened layer that reduces incoming damage.

data.name: Stone Warden
data.description: A crushing earth genjutsu that suppresses the enemy’s mental prowess and offensive output.
data.battleDescription: A towering illusion of an ancient stone guardian erupts from the battlefield, crashing down upon %target with terrifying force. The overwhelming presence of the Stone Warden fractures their focus, suppressing their ninjutsu and genjutsu potential while dulling their intelligence and willpower. The enemy is left mentally burdened and less capable of mounting an effective counterattack.

data.name: Stone of the Withering
data.description: A crumbling earth technique that harms the enemy and restores the user’s health through lifesteal.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a cursed shard of compacted earth chakra at %target. The impact disrupts their vitality and awakens a latent siphoning effect within the caster, allowing them to absorb health from their next damaging attacks

data.name: Stonebreaker Strike
data.description: A brutal earth-based taijutsu blow that smashes through defenses and shatters the ground.
data.battleDescription: %user roots themselves to the ground, channeling dense earth chakra through their body and into their strike. With a sudden forward step, they deliver a crushing blow aimed at breaking not just the opponent, but the terrain itself. The sheer force of the attack sends a deep shockwave through the ground, cracking stone and rupturing the earth beneath their feet.

data.name: Storm Kick
data.description: A piercing lightning kick that propels the user and reflects a portion of damage received back to the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into their leg, their form crackling with unstable voltage. With a flash of movement, they launch forward across the battlefield like a bolt breaking loose from a thundercloud. The kick lands cleanly against %target, piercing through their guard with razor precision. But the technique doesn’t stop there—Storm Kick leaves a current behind, wrapping the user in reactive lightning. For a short time, any damage aimed at %user arcs back toward the attacker, punishing them for every blow.

data.name: Stormblade Arc
data.description: A lightning-infused slash that pierces the enemy, moves across the field, and reflects damage.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward in a flash, slashing through %target with a blade crackling with storm energy. The momentum carries them across the battlefield as arcs of electricity coil around their form. The blade’s storm-charged edge reflects incoming damage back toward its source.

data.name: Suijin Gir
data.description: A powerful water-based slash that deals damage and makes the enemy more vulnerable to Bukijutsu.
data.battleDescription: %user dashes in with a swift slash imbued with high-pressure water, striking %target with explosive force. The slicing current crashes through defenses, leaving the enemy off balance and more susceptible to follow-up Bukijutsu attacks.

data.name: Summoning: Lord Pengu
data.description: The people of Glacier have cohabitated with the Ancient Penguins and have earned the favor of Lord Pengu
data.battleDescription: %user pricks their finger and slams their hand to the ground. A cold mist swirls before condensing into a crowned penguin.

data.name: Swallow’s Flight
data.description: A graceful taijutsu strike that damages the enemy and repositions the user.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their legs and darts forward with birdlike elegance. Their body moves in a blur, executing a precise aerial kick that lands before swiftly dashing to a new position. The combination of striking force and tactical movement mirrors the fleeting flight of a swallow, dealing damage and adjusting battlefield placement.

data.name: Tempest Slash
data.description: A slicing wind-infused weapon technique that pierces the enemy, leaving burn marks on them
data.battleDescription: drawn low and wind chakra twisting tightly around the blade. As they pass through %target, the strike cuts clean—but deeper than it appears. The wind slips beneath the surface, unraveling their ability to brace against future blows.

data.name: Tempest of Shadows
data.description: A sharp genjutsu that strikes with piercing force and leaves the enemy more vulnerable to future genjutsu attacks.
data.battleDescription: With a silent breath, %user extends their hand, distorting the light and shadows around them into a whirling maelstrom of razor-sharp illusions. The air tears open before %target as spectral blades howl through the storm, piercing mind and body alike. Every cut amplifies the target’s susceptibility to genjutsu, warping their perception and weakening their mental defenses. The storm does not relent—it lingers in the mind, twisting all future illusions into inescapable torment.

data.name: Tempest’s Whisper
data.description: A disorienting genjutsu that deals damage and absorbs a portion of the damage from the enemy's next attack.
data.battleDescription: With a mere glance and a faint motion, %user casts a silent genjutsu that invades %target’s senses like a creeping breeze. In the illusion, a storm stirs around them—whispers of wind slicing through reality. The target is struck by phantom gales, while their next attack feels muffled and distant, as if the very air is stealing its force. The user remains untouched within the illusion’s calm eye, shielded by the storm’s deceptive barrier.

data.name: Thunder Chain Slash
data.description: A lightning-infused bukijutsu strike that deals damage and stuns the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into a chained weapon and unleashes a sudden, snapping slash toward %target. The moment the weapon strikes, a burst of electricity erupts from the point of contact, locking up the enemy’s muscles with a violent jolt. The electric backlash leaves %target momentarily paralyzed, caught in the crackling wake of the chained assault.

data.name: Thunder Fist
data.description: A lightning-charged punch that deals damage and temporarily stuns the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user channels concentrated lightning chakra into their fist until it pulses with violent static. With a flash-step and explosive lunge, they slam their electrified strike into %target. The chakra discharges on impact, sending a jolt through the target’s nervous system—locking muscles, distorting balance, and interrupting movement. Thunder Fist is not just a blow—it’s a system shock, leaving %target frozen and open for the next attack.

data.name: Thunderbolt Spear
data.description: A lightning-forged spear that pierces the enemy and rebounds their power back at them.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a high-density spear of lightning chakra and hurls it toward %target, piercing their defenses with explosive speed. The charged impact lingers in their chakra stream, causing a reactive backlash that reflects a portion of their next attack back at them.

data.name: Thunderstorm Delusion
data.description: The target experiences an endless storm of lightning strikes, each one seemingly hitting them directly.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a complex illusion that conjures a raging thunderstorm in the mind of %target. Deafening thunder cracks overhead as illusionary bolts of lightning explode around them, each flash bringing crushing pain and sensory overload. The overwhelming assault disorients and punishes with the sheer force of phantom lightning.

data.name: Thunderstrike Punch
data.description: A lightning-powered punch that hits with devastating force.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra deep into their arm, the energy pulsing through their veins like a live current. With a sharp forward step and clenched knuckles, they unleash a thunderous punch that detonates against %target like a bolt from the sky. The force fractures defenses and shakes the body to its core, delivering overwhelming damage in a single strike.

data.name: Thunder’s Judgement
data.description: Surround yourself with reactive lightning that strengthens your attacks and reflects damage back at attackers.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with surging lightning chakra, strengthening their attacks. While the current remains active, incoming damage is partially reflected back at the attacker through reactive lightning.

data.name: Tidal Crush
data.description: A crashing surge of water that batters the enemy and surrounds the user with a protective layer of chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a powerful wall of high-pressure water that slams into %target with crushing force. As the impact crashes forward, a residual film of chakra-infused water clings to %user’s body, forming a protective barrier that dampens future damage.

data.name: Tidal Slice
data.description: A swift water-infused slash that deals damage and reduces damage taken by the user.
data.battleDescription: %user pivots swiftly and releases a sweeping arc of reinforced water chakra that tears into %target. As the surge crashes forward, a protective layer of water pressure envelops the user’s body, softening incoming attacks.

data.name: Tides of Despair
data.description: A genjutsu that engulfs the enemy in a sorrowful tide, dealing damage and decreasing future damage taken.
data.battleDescription: Waves of illusion crash down upon %target, carrying with them the weight of despair and failure. The enemy becomes overwhelmed by visions of loss and futility, their attacks dulled by a mind too heavy to focus. The user's chakra synchronizes with the flow, reinforcing their mental defenses against incoming assaults.

data.name: Tornado Fist
data.description: A spiraling wind-infused strike that damages vital organs and wounds enemy
data.battleDescription: %user spins into action, wind chakra whipping around their arm in a vicious spiral. As they launch their fist forward, a condensed cyclone wraps tightly around the strike. The blow lands with explosive force against %target, tearing at their stance and disrupting their physical core. The turbulence doesn’t fade—it lingers. Wind chakra burrows beneath the skin and into muscle memory, destabilizing their ability to brace. With their guard thrown off balance, %target becomes far more vulnerable to follow-up taijutsu.

data.name: Torrential Fist
data.description: A brutal, storm-fueled punch that crushes foes and awakens the beast within.
data.battleDescription: % A low hum fills the air as %user’s fist clenches, veins glowing faintly with surging water chakra. The liquid spirals violently around their arm, no longer gentle like a stream but raging like a storm barely contained. With eyes locked on %target, %user surges forward—each step leaving splashes in their wake. The punch lands with a brutal crash, detonating in a geyser of pressure that feels more like a tidal eruption than a strike. Steam rises from soaked ground as %user pulls back, aura pulsing, their strength now amplified by the very force that sought to drown their enemy.

data.name: Toxic Pool
data.description: A corrosive field technique that poisons enemies and deals damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user releases toxic chakra into the ground, forming a bubbling, acidic pool beneath %target. The vapor and liquid gnaw at their body, inflicting immediate pain and poisoning their system. Remaining within the area worsens the effect over time.

data.name: Vacuum Palm
data.description: A wind-charged piercing palm strike that leaves the enemy vulnerable to Taijutsu.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses wind chakra into their palm, compressing it into a thin, invisible blade of force. With a single, precise thrust, they drive the strike through the air—and into %target—piercing through defenses without warning. The impact disrupts muscular control and weakens the body’s ability to absorb further physical punishment. After being struck by Vacuum Palm, %target becomes noticeably more vulnerable to Taijutsu techniques, their guard compromised by the razor-thin force still lingering within.

data.name: Veil of Shadows
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and absorbs damage done to the user.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a slow, deliberate seal as an ominous haze spreads through the air, cloaking the battlefield in spectral mist. %target’s vision darkens as they’re pulled into an illusion where formless shadows lash out with invisible strikes. With every blow, a portion of the damage loops back to reinforce the user’s vitality.

data.name: Volt Crash
data.description: A high-speed lightning charge that crashes into the enemy with explosive force.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a flash of lightning, covering the battlefield in an instant. With thunderclap velocity, they slam into %target like a living bolt, delivering a crushing impact that leaves sparks and destruction in their wake.

data.name: Volt Fang
data.description: A lightning-charged slash that deals damage, boosts the user’s Bukijutsu, and weakens the enemy’s physical prowess.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and slashes %target with a blade cloaked in surging lightning chakra. The strike disorients the enemy as electric currents disrupt their physical control, while empowering the user's Bukijutsu, strength, and momentum.

data.name: Volt Jab Barrage
data.description: A lightning-fast barrage of jabs that weakens the enemy’s body while amplifying the user’s power.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists spark to life as lightning surges through their limbs. In a flash, they close the distance and unleash a relentless barrage of precise jabs, each punch crackling with high-voltage chakra. Every hit sends jolts through %target’s nervous system, overloading muscles, slowing reaction time, and breaking their physical rhythm. As %target’s strength, speed, and guard deteriorate, the electricity surging through %user only intensifies—sharpening their own taijutsu power.

data.name: Volt Reaper
data.description: A lightning-powered strike that deals damage and enhances the user’s Taijutsu strength.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward, lightning chakra crackling across their limbs in jagged, twitching arcs. With a sudden pivot, they slash their leg or arm across %target with blinding speed, the strike crackling on impact. As the chakra discharges, it doesn’t fade—instead, it coils around %user like a second skin.

data.name: Wave Cleaver
data.description: A powerful strike that unleashes a cleaving wave of water, dealing heavy damage.
data.battleDescription: %user swings their weapon in a wide arc, releasing a massive surge of compressed water chakra that rips toward %target. The cutting wave crashes forward like a tidal blade, delivering overwhelming force in a single sweeping motion.

data.name: Weary Fists
data.description: A heavy taijutsu strike that absorbs part of the damage the user receives
data.battleDescription: %user approaches with grounded steps, chakra coiling around their arm like lead. They drive a deliberate, crushing punch into %target, the force transferring with bone-deep weight. On impact, residual chakra lingers around %user, hardening into a dense field that absorbs a portion of incoming damage.

data.name: Whirlwind Kick
data.description: A high-speed spinning kick that deals damage and leaves the enemy vulnerable to taijutsu.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra through their legs and launches into a fierce spin, kicking with the force of a gale. Wind spirals outward in a sharp arc, amplifying the velocity and reach of the strike. When the blow lands, the shock tears through %target’s balance and muscular control. Wind chakra lingers in the joints, loosening their ability to brace or defend.

data.name: Whispering Winds
data.description: A ghostly breeze slices through the air, dealing damage and making the target more vulnerable to genjutsu.
data.battleDescription: With a gentle sway of the hand, the shinobi summons a spectral wind that whistles with haunted whispers. The gust slashes through %target’s senses, disrupting their mental clarity and unraveling their resistance to illusion. The eerie presence lingers, amplifying the effects of genjutsu to come.

data.name: Wind Cutter
data.description: A high-speed wind slash that deals heavy damage and drains the target's health
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a burst of wind and reappears in motion, slashing through %target with razor-sharp wind chakra. The cutting force is so intense it leaves a trail of cleaved air behind, carving across the battlefield with speed and precision.

data.name: Wind Scythe Barrage
data.description: A sweeping assault of cutting winds that boosts the user’s offensive momentum.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a blur of motion, launching a barrage of crescent-shaped wind scythes across the battlefield. As they move, chakra surges through their body, sharpening their offensive edge and enhancing the power of future attacks.

data.name: Zephyr’s Judgment
data.description: This technique has been passed down by several ninja of old times. By achieving control of the wind nature, the user can subjugate the winds around his fists and legs, generating incredible attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user enters a wind-infused trance, closing the gap to %target in an instant. Each rapid punch and kick creates miniature cyclones, shredding %target’s defenses and leaving them immobilized.

data.name: Abyssal Wraith
data.description: Conjure illusions of malevolent wraiths that haunt the target's perception, inducing mental strain and escalating torment.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures the Abyssal Wraith, infusing %target's perception with illusions of malevolent wraiths. The haunting figures induce mental strain, escalating the torment experienced by %target. %user exploits the target's compromised mental state, launching calculated strikes that take advantage of their distracted defenses.

data.name: Bursting Compressed Air
data.description: A ninjutsu that deals damage using a blast of condensed air.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses air with precise chakra control into a tightly packed orb between their palms. With a sharp thrust, the orb explodes forward, releasing a concentrated shockwave that tears through the air. The blast distorts the surroundings as it barrels toward the target, hitting with the crushing force of pure atmospheric pressure.

data.name: Desert Illusions
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and immobilizes the target.
data.battleDescription: With a subtle hand seal and a steady gaze, the shinobi casts an illusion that traps the enemy in a mirage of shifting sands and scorching sun. In the false desert, every step becomes a struggle, and escape seems impossible. The target is struck by searing mirages while their movement is locked in the grip of the genjutsu’s disorienting landscape.

data.name: Earth Release: Palm Push
data.description: A defensive jutsu that decreases damage taken and redirects enemy offensive output.
data.battleDescription: With a grounded stance, %user channels earth chakra into their palm before thrusting forward. A sudden wave of solid force erupts, intercepting the enemy’s attack and dispersing its power. This technique reduces the damage received while subtly shifting the incoming force, displacing the enemy or altering their trajectory with controlled redirection.

data.name: Earth Release: Stone Fist Strike
data.description: A hardened earth-infused punch that deals damage and weakens the enemy’s offensive output.
data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their arm with dense earth chakra before launching a crushing punch into %target’s core. The impact echoes like stone slamming into steel, staggering the opponent and disrupting their ability to channel power. The force of the strike not only causes direct physical damage but saps their offensive momentum, reducing the strength of their follow-up attacks.

data.name: Earth Style: Shattering Kick
data.description: A powerful taijutsu kick that deals damage to the opponent
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward and plants their weight before delivering a crushing upward kick infused with earth chakra. The ground beneath their foot cracks as force surges through the strike, launching the target backward with seismic impact. The attack not only causes direct damage but also knocks the enemy across the battlefield, breaking their formation and control.

data.name: Electric Maul
data.description: Your electric-infused chakra races toward an opponent like a tiger, mauling them to shreds.
data.battleDescription: The user slams their palm into the earth, channeling lightning chakra through the terrain. From the surge, a roaring tiger made entirely of crackling electricity erupts into view, its body outlined in streaks of blinding light. The beast charges the enemy with terrifying speed, pouncing and delivering a mauling strike of raw elemental force. This genin-level jutsu strikes fear into opponents through its fierce visual and devastating impact.

data.name: Electric Surge
data.description: The user creates an illusion of a sudden surge of electricity coursing through the target's body, causing them to feel a brief, intense shock.
data.battleDescription: As %user invokes the Electric Surge genjutsu, %target is enveloped in an illusionary surge of electricity. %target reacts instinctively, jerking as if shocked. The sensation is vivid, causing %target to momentarily lose focus, creating an opening for %user's next move.

data.name: Flash Kick
data.description: Never stop. Be unrelenting. Your kicks are so quick and lightning charged
data.battleDescription: %user explodes forward in a storm of lightning-charged kicks, each strike cracking with blinding speed and power. The final roundhouse erupts in a flash of electricity, sending %target staggering back in a haze of pain and sparks.

data.name: Ignition Kick
data.description: This technique focuses on utilizing fire elemental chakra on the leg to erupt in fire as it makes contact with the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, delivering a swift roundhouse kick to %target. The impact erupts in a burst of flames, scorching %target and leaving them staggered.

data.name: Infernal Ascension
data.description: The user calls upon sacred flames, their aura igniting with unholy fire - elevating the power of their every blaze to new, merciless heights.
data.battleDescription: %user ignites their chakra into roaring flame, every motion blazing with destructive intensity. Their body radiates searing heat as they ascend into a state of relentless aggression, striking with explosive bursts of fire chakra. With each move, the user channels infernal energy that fuels their flame-based attacks, overwhelming the battlefield in blazing dominance.

data.name: Lightning Cloak
data.description: Enshrouded in crackling energy, the user dons a mantle of lightning—amplifying the ferocity of their electric attacks until every strike sings with thunder’s fury.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their body in a radiant sheath of crackling lightning, each muscle fiber twitching with raw power. As they move, arcs of electricity trail behind them, boosting both speed and force. Their strikes become charged with piercing energy, enhancing the impact of all lightning-based techniques with devastating precision.

data.name: Lightning Release: Holy Strike
data.description: Long before the sun was praised, it was lightning that was revered.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a multitude of hand signs, then sends in their hands clasped in a praying motion. Their body is cloaked in lightning that almost seems divine. In a swift motion, lightning arcs toward %target, giving a devastating blow.

data.name: Molten Fury
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and inflicts lingering mental burns.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and initiates a searing genjutsu where molten lava pours from the sky, engulfing the target in a hellish illusion. Though the damage is purely mental, the torment lingers, causing %target to feel continuous internal burning that chips away at their psyche each turn. The illusion blurs reality, leaving them unsure if the pain will ever stop.

data.name: Phoenix Flame Illusion
data.description: Creates an illusion of a phoenix attacking with flames.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a swift sequence of hand seals, unleashing an illusion of a colossal phoenix made of pure fire. The flaming bird ascends into the sky, then dives straight through %target in a blinding cascade of light. Though no physical flames touch them, the burning vision scorches their senses, delivering powerful mental damage.

data.name: Quicksand Mirages
data.description: induces panic on the target by making them believe they are suddenly being trapped in quicksand.
data.battleDescription: %user bends the mind of %target and creates an illusion of them sinking into quicksand. The feeling is real as their body sinks into the sand, they can feel their body getting stuck under the pressure falling into a state of panic.

data.name: Rotting Bite
data.description: A genjutsu that inflicts the target with a rotting disease. Targeting the body with disgusting images and weakening their mind.
data.battleDescription: %target feels a sharp sting as the illusion of rotting flesh spreads across their body. The horrific vision saps their will, activating lifesteal for %user as their strength feeds into the caster.

data.name: Shocking Discharge
data.description: A lightning-style ninjutsu that deals damage and stuns the target.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a sudden burst of concentrated lightning from their palm, sending a jagged bolt surging into %target. The impact is sharp and blinding, causing the target’s muscles to seize and their body to convulse. The shock leaves them momentarily immobilized, giving the user an opening to follow up or reposition.

data.name: Shockwave Fist
data.description: The user strikes with a fist charged in lightning, releasing a shockwave that damages and tries to the enemy.
data.battleDescription: This technique charges %user’s fists with electrical chakra to deliver a crushing blow. Upon impact, the strike releases a violent surge of electricity that deals damage and has a chance to stun %target, leaving them momentarily unable to act.

data.name: Stone Circle
data.description: A ninjutsu technique that deals damage and binds the enemy’s movement.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, channeling chakra that triggers a circular formation of jagged stone pillars to erupt around %target. The rising stones strike with force before closing in tightly, restricting movement and leaving the opponent vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Stone Shuriken Technique
data.description: The user creates shurikens made of compacted earth, which can be used for throwing or as melee weapons.
data.battleDescription: As %user creates shurikens from compacted earth, %target braces for the incoming assault. With a swift motion, %user hurls the stone shurikens at %target, each impact sending a shockwave of earth through %target's body. The barrage of shurikens leaves %target battered and bruised, struggling to withstand the relentless assault of earthy projectiles.

data.name: Stone Skipping
data.description: A ninjutsu attack that hurls skipping stones to deal damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into a handful of flat stones, enhancing their mass and speed. With a precise flick of the wrist, the stones launch forward, skipping across the ground and striking %target with successive, chakra-infused impacts. Each bounce amplifies the force, turning a simple motion into a relentless barrage.

data.name: Tectonic Ascendancy
data.description: Harnessing the primal energy of the earth’s tectonic plates, the user channels a massive surge of chakra to reshape the terrain into a destructive force of nature
data.battleDescription: %user slams their foot into the ground, awakening deep veins of earth chakra that ripple through their body. A surge of raw, grounded power builds beneath their feet, reinforcing their strikes with the weight of the land itself. This technique heightens the user’s affinity with earth, amplifying the force behind all subsequent earth-based attacks.

data.name: Tidefall Punch
data.description: A crushing punch that damages the enemy and hardens the user’s defenses.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, water spiraling tightly around their arm like a coiled serpent. As they drive their fist into %target, the crashing blow sends a shockwave rippling outward—like a tidal surge erupting from their knuckles. The impact drenches the battlefield in pressurized chakra-infused water, fortifying %user’s body with a durable aquatic shield.

data.name: Tides of Sovereignty
data.description: Summoning the might of the endless sea, the user commands the tides to swell their power—amplifying the force of every water-based assault with sovereign wrath.
data.battleDescription: %user draws deep from their water chakra reserves, their movements becoming smooth, forceful, and unrelenting like a rising tide. Each strike is infused with hydraulic pressure, reinforcing every blow with the crushing strength of flowing currents. The user’s water-based techniques become more destructive, mirroring the power of sovereign tides.

data.name: Water Shuriken
data.description: A swift bukijutsu technique that hurls razor-sharp shuriken formed from pressurized water.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their hand and swiftly generates a set of spinning water-formed shuriken. With a flick of the wrist, the projectiles are launched with deadly precision toward %target, slicing through the air and striking with sharp aquatic force. Each impact lands like a compressed wave, delivering solid damage.

data.name: Water Style: Water Beast
data.description: Water-based ninjutsu that deals damage and absorbs a portion of incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: The user conjures a massive beast made entirely of churning water, which surges forward to slam into the target. As it crashes into the enemy, a swirling vortex lingers around the user, absorbing a portion of damage from incoming attacks. This technique balances offense with a defensive advantage.

data.name: Wind Release: Tempest Edge
data.description: The user channels wind chakra into their weapon, creating a blade enveloped in a swirling vortex of wind that increases cutting power.
data.battleDescription: With a powerful swing, %user imbues their weapon with swirling wind chakra, forming a tempestuous blade. As they bring it down upon %target, the blade cuts through the air with a ferocious howl, striking with the force of a raging storm. The tempestuous energy enhances the blade's cutting power, aiming to inflict devastating damage upon impact.

data.name: Wind Vacuum
data.description: A jutsu that increases the user’s wind damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user draws in surrounding air with a deep inhalation, forming an intense vacuum around their body. As the pressure equalizes, their chakra surges violently, amplifying the force and sharpness of their wind-based techniques. The surrounding atmosphere distorts slightly, signaling the enhanced potential of their next wind release.

data.name: Zephyr Strike
data.description: The user imbues their weapon with a light breeze, enhancing its speed and allowing for swift and agile attacks.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels wind chakra into their weapon, a light breeze envelops them, enhancing their speed and agility. They move with a newfound swiftness, their strikes becoming faster and more precise. With each strike, the breeze around them intensifies, propelling them with the grace and speed of the wind itself.

data.name: Phantom Requiem
data.description: A sinister technique that saps the life force of enemies, draining their chakra and stamina with every passing second.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a seal, summoning a ghostly mist that seeps into %target’s body. Wisps of blue and red energy—chakra and stamina—are ripped from them, spiraling into %user’s grasp. %target’s limbs grow heavy, their strength fading as exhaustion takes hold. If they don’t break free, they’ll collapse under the relentless drain.

data.name: Seal of Nullification
data.description: A sealing technique that suppresses buffs and enhancement abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, stripping away buffs and suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements.

data.name: Primordial Blight
data.description: Elements corrupt and suppress healing abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a malevolent elemental blight of fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning that engulfs %target, scorching their vitality, freezing chakra flow, and corrupting recovery, leaving them weakened and defenseless against %user’s assault.

data.name: Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder 2
data.description: Unleashes a torrent of electrified water, overwhelming enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands, summoning a massive storm as dark clouds gather and electricity crackles through the air, unleashing a torrential wave of electrified water that crashes toward %target with violent force, striking with bolts of lightning and dealing devastating damage while leaving the battlefield drenched and charged with residual energy that hinders recovery.

data.name: Storm Style: Divine Railgun 2
data.description: You fire off an attack at inhuman speeds utilizing the properties of lightning and water's conductivity.
data.battleDescription: %user coats small pebble in water chakra, then using lightning, they supercharge it sending it flying toward %target before they can even react, inflicting massive injury with what seems like just a flick of a finger.

data.name: Crippling Blade
data.description: Crippling Strike is a Forbidden S-Rank Bukijutsu that enhances the user's weapon with a dark, ominous aura, sapping the strength and agility of their foes, decreasing their Taijutsu prowess.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, calculated strike, %user's weapon is engulfed in a menacing, dark aura, crackling with malevolent energy. As the blade connects, the aura surges into %target's body, creeping through their veins like icy tendrils, sapping their strength and agility. %target's movements slow, each step becoming a laborious effort as the oppressive force of Crippling Strike weighs them down. The once nimble and powerful fighter now struggles against the debilitating effects of the jutsu, their Taijutsu prowess drained and diminished.

data.name: Forbidden Art: Heaven's Rupture Oath
data.description: A lost bukijutsu oath that cuts the sky open with dust and yin-yang chakra, sealing enemy elements while overtaxing the user's own reserves.

effects.description: A sky-splitting slash ruptures the target.
The rupture seals forbidden elemental flow.
The oath hardens the user's stance for a moment.
The oath chains make future actions costly.

data.battleDescription: %user draws their weapon across the air without touching %target. For a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then the sky splits along the blade's path, and a silent dust-white wound opens above %target. The rupture crashes down, carving through defenses and sealing forbidden elements in its wake. As the oath closes, chains of chakra lash back around %user's arms, making every movement cost twice what it should.

data.name: Verdant Renewal
data.description: Envelops the target in nature’s healing aura.
data.battleDescription: %user kneels and places their palms on the ground, channeling energy into the earth. Vines and blossoms emerge, wrapping gently around %user or %target. The vibrant greenery pulses with life, knitting injuries together and restoring vitality. The sweet scent of blooming flowers enhances the target’s resolve, filling them with newfound strength and focus.

data.name: Pressure Damage
data.description: The user compresses a tornado of wind into a dense mass and releases it on the target, punching through any guard. The pressure leaves them reeling, so each later hit carries extra damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user crushes a roaring tornado into a dense sphere of air and unleashes it on %target, the blast ripping straight through their defences.

data.name: Storm Fist
data.description: The user wraps their fist in a spiralling vortex of lightning and drives it into the target. The charge clings to them, so every hit that follows burns deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Lightning spirals up %user's arm as they drive a crackling punch into %target, leaving them sparking with residual charge.

data.name: Thorn Grasp
data.description: The user calls up thorny vines that coil around the target and puncture deep. The wounds leave them exposed, so follow-up attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons spiked vines that wrap around %target, puncturing them and leaving their defences exposed.

data.name: Thunderclap Barrage
data.description: The user charges their weapon with storm chakra and unleashes a rapid series of crackling strikes on the target. A residual current lingers around the user, softening incoming attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user floods their weapon with storm chakra and rains a rapid series of strikes on %target, the leftover current gathering around them like armour.

data.name: Thunderclap Strike
data.description: The user charges their fists with lightning and lands a strike that bursts with a thunderous boom. The crackling energy surges through their body, sharpening their offence and defence for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Thunder booms as %user drives a lightning-charged fist into %target, the energy crackling back through %user's body.

data.name: Wind Dance
data.description: The user dances within circling currents of wind that cushion incoming blows. The flowing air sharpens their movements, raising their offence and defence for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user whirls into a graceful dance, swift currents circling their body to cushion blows and sharpen every movement.

data.name: Acidic Permeation
data.description: The user hurls seal-made pellets that burst into a cloud of acid around the target. The particles eat into their armour, leaving them more vulnerable to damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a handful of acid-filled pellets at %target, and as they burst the fine mist seeps through their defences.

data.name: Arcbound Vortex
data.description: The user slams a hand to the earth and a vortex of lightning surges up beneath the chosen spot. Enemies caught in it take lightning damage over the next few rounds and deal less damage while it lasts.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a hand to the ground and a spiralling vortex of lightning tears up through the earth, crackling around every enemy inside.

data.name: Chakra Resistance
data.description: The user layers dense chakra through their body, hardening it against harm. For a short time they take less damage and their attacks strike with greater force.
data.battleDescription: %user draws chakra inward until it settles over their body like armour, steeling them to endure and to strike back harder.

data.name: Cyclone Shredder
data.description: The user releases a spiralling vortex of bladed wind that shreds the target and everything around them. Every enemy caught in the storm is left raw, so the blows that follow hurt more for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user looses a roaring vortex of slicing wind at %target, shredding the ground and every enemy caught in its spin.

data.name: Riptide Reaper
data.description: The user sweeps a reaping arc of riptide water across the field, tearing through every enemy caught in the spiral. The current flows back into the user, letting their attacks drink health from every wound they deal for a time.
data.battleDescription: %user swings through a spiralling riptide that drags across the battlefield, the dark water flowing back to feed %user.

data.name: Shippūgeki
data.description: The user whips up a spiralling gale of cutting winds that tears through every enemy in its path. The surge of speed carries on through the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a spiralling storm of razor winds across the field, the gale feeding back into their own strength.
